attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine 3.23, installed via apk: etcd + etcd-ctl), configured with static peer/client URLs and initial-cluster bootstrap, managed via OpenRC. Verified cross-member replication, availability during a follower outage with catch-up on recovery, then performed the mandatory sequential-restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id and cluster-health proof before/after each restart.
